Hear what it makes

Five Quick Track presets made with Hybrid composer and the original Studio cartridge sound palette. Both model stages ran for every track. Hit play, or grab the MIDI and mess with it yourself.

These are 65-second previews. Seeds: Route 123, Forest 241, Cave 83, Battle 401, Night 77. Playback is an approximation of the GBA mixer.

Hybrid starts with a contour from the GAN checkpoint used in MusiGAN’s Pokémon MIDI experiments. Magenta MusicRNN then develops it into phrases over the chords. Studio handles the arrangement, rhythm, cadence and GBA limits. The models run in sequence; their weights have not been merged.

Models: MusiGAN — elsalmi and contributors; Magenta MusicRNN — The Magenta Authors, using chord_pitches_improv. Generation records.
